jordan: Planning a midnight deploy for model-routing changes. Feature flag `session-affinity-unpin` to unwind sticky assignment for long-lived sessions. Window 00:30-02:30 UTC. Need ramp + rollback plan.

may: Proposed ramp: canary 3% (ap-south) -> 15% after 10m -> 50% after 40m -> full after 90m. Manual hold at each step.

trent: Add automatic safety checks: if client-affinity-drop > 8% OR 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 5m -> auto-rollback and re-pin to v3.1.8. Also block advance if deploybot reports pod drain > 30s.

may: QA will run smoke and regen tests at 3% and 15%. Baseline eval located at /evals/session-affinity-baseline-2026-02.json.

jordan: tagging @deploy-bot for schedule and controls. Also: brief release note lines for product and support.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: version=v3.2.1, ff=session-affinity-unpin=3%, target=canary(ap-south-1).

deploy-bot: Ops commands:
```\n# advance ramp to next cohort\n/deploy advance-cohort session-affinity-unpin\n# rollback and re-pin to safe version\n/deploy rollback --version=v3.1.8 --re-pin\n# abort deploy\n/deploy abort\n```\n
oncall-bot: Quiet window enabled 00:30-02:30 UTC. Alerting: pager if affinity drop >8% or p95 latency > 750ms for 10m.

trent: I'll put a temporary global rate cap on routing to avoid cascading reconnect storms. Also adding a trace header `X-FF-Trace:affinity-unpin` for correlation.

may: Release notes draft for changelog: - Unpin sticky session routing for v3 to reduce tail backlog; expected median latency improvement for long sessions. - Ramp: 3% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100% with manual approvals. - Risk: websocket reconnections may transiently drop affinity; mitigation: short client cookie reissue and fallback to sticky-cookie reassign. - Rollback: pin to v3.1.8, drain v3.2.1. Contacts: jordan, may, trent.

jordan: Oncall, hold advance until I get green ack from trent and may at each holdpoint. If anything abnormal, run `/deploy rollback --version=v3.1.8 --re-pin` and notify product.

deploy-bot: Canary started @1840000030 1: session-affinity-unpin=3% on ap-south-1. Post results here. :robot_face:
